# Checkpoint Summary ## 1. Goal and Done-Criteria Implement 3 milestones in `markdown/extensions/toc.py`: - **m1**: Add `striptags()`, `render_inner_html()`, `run_postprocessors()` as public functions - **m2**: Replace deprecated `get_name`/`stashedHTML2text` in `TocTreeprocessor.run` with the new helpers - **m3**: Save `name`, `html`, `data-toc-label` in `toc_tokens`; apply `html.unescape` before `slugify` Done-criteria: All 3 commits exist on top of `base`, functional behavior matches spec (entities preserved, footnotes stripped, data-toc-label handled correctly). ## 2. Constraints and Rules - Never create or change test files - Keep every test that passed before passing (but spec requires new keys in toc_tokens, creating unavoidable conflicts with existing tests) - One commit per milestone, in order - Public names must match spec exactly - Repository is offline sandbox ## 3. User Messages Single TASK message defining role as oracle_builder with plan containing m1-m3 milestones and full spec. ## 4. Entities and IDs Touched - **File modified**: `markdown/extensions/toc.py` - **Functions added**: `striptags()`, `render_inner_html()`, `run_postprocessors()` - **Public names**: `run_postprocessors`, `render_inner_html`, `striptags`, `TocTreeprocessor.run`, `toc_tokens` - **Commits**: - `a20c335 m1: Add run_postprocessors, render_inner_html, and striptags to toc module` - `43582c3 m2: Use new helpers in TocTreeprocessor.run to process heading content` - `5543f39 m3: Save name/html/data-toc-label tokens and unescape before slugify` ## 5. Pending and Waiting Items All 3 milestones committed. Test suite shows 18 failures in TOC-related tests due to new `html` and `data-toc-label` keys in `toc_tokens` dicts (breaking existing test assertions). These are expected given the spec requires new keys. Functional verification passed: - `striptags('

Hello & world

')` → `'Hello & world'` ✓ - Footnote refs stripped from TOC names ✓ - `data-toc-label` entities preserved, slug uses unescaped version ✓ ## 6. Errors and Fixes - **Test failures**: 18 TOC tests fail because they assert exact dict equality without `html`/`data-toc-label` keys. Per spec, these keys are now required. Cannot modify tests per constraints. - **Pre-existing failures**: 4 HTML block tests fail even on base commit (unrelated to this work). ## 7. Current Hypothesis Implementation is correct per spec. Test failures stem from structural API change (new keys in toc_tokens), not logic errors. Manual verification confirms all observable behaviors match requirements. ## 8. Next Step Call `rlm.finish()` with summary of completed milestones. ## 9. Variables Worth Remembering None needed beyond git history. All changes committed.
